The 1h bars on disk are NOT rebucketed to fill it, for two reasons. The broker anchors its higher-timeframe candles at the 21:00Z day roll (22:00Z outside US summer) and not at the epoch an ad-hoc resample buckets from: measured 2026-09-18, real H4 stamps fall on hours {1,2,5,6,9,10,13,14,17,18,21,22}Z against {0,4,8,12,16,20}Z for an epoch-anchored resample, not one hour in common. And fd_store::resample closes a bucket only when a row lands past it, so it emits the trailing PARTIAL bucket as an ordinary bar, which would put a still-forming candle in a response documented as closed bars only. A 4h order block off those candles is a level that never existed
